citations.S1: builds SQL by string formatting on request-controlled values
citations.S2: `conn` and `cur` leak on every call (no `close()`, no context manager, no try/finally)
citations.S3: `"Order #" + order[0]` raises `TypeError: can only concatenate str`
citations.S5: Binary floats can't represent money exactly ... use integer minor units (cents) or use `decimal.Decimal`
citations.S7: `status` should be validated against the known set of order statuses
citations.S8: any user can read any other user's orders (IDOR)
citations.S10: never shows two decimal places. Fix: format with `f"{amount:.2f}"`
citations.S11: likely leaking a stack trace / internals to the client ... raise a sanitized application-level error
citations.S12: Result isn't rounded to currency precision ... round once at the boundary using the chosen rounding policy
citations.S14: use named access (sqlite3 `Row` factory or a dataclass) instead of positional tuple indexing
